text:
Aria: Hi all 44b Day 1 done, quick ask: where do I drop requests for badge pickup, VPN, laptop imaging, GitHub repo perms, cloud project access, and how to mute onboarding DMs? Trying not to spam channels.
IT Help: Welcome Aria! Quick map: badge -> #people-ops (full name + office), VPN -> #help with 'vpn' in the message, laptop imaging/hardware -> #eng-infra (include serial & OS), repo perms -> Access Form (link pinned in #devex) then ping @Carlos if it stalls, cloud/GCP -> #eng-infra with project id & IAM role. DM for urgent blockers.
Aria: Thanks — if the request is only squad-scoped (test repo), post in the team channel first?
Carlos (DevEx): Yes, start in your team channel for team-scoped asks. If infra needs to act, create the Access Form and paste the ticket link in the thread so infra can triage. For repo perms include repo slug + GH handle + short justification.
Megan: Etiquette: use threads, react with :thumbsup: for ack, avoid @channel/@here unless it's an outage or office-wide. For fast attention tag the person rather than the whole channel.
OnboardBot: Commands: `/onboard prefs` -> opens DM to set cadence; `/onboard pause 7d` -> pause DMs for 7 days; `/onboard stop` -> unsubscribe. Click "Manage" in welcome DM for GUI.
Aria: Where do I paste long logs? Don't want to dump big traces in a channel.
Infra Oncall: Put big logs in a Gist or Drive and paste the link with a 1-line summary. For small snippets use triple backticks:
```
error: permission denied cloning repo
steps: attempted ssh key, tried https
```
Post that in #eng-infra and tag @Infra Oncall if blocking.
People Ops: Badge note: if remote and need a badge shipped, DM People Ops with shipping address and start date. Badge processing is usually 1-2 business days.
Aria: Last Q 60a social invites?
Megan: #lunch-plans for food, #random for socials/memes. Both fine.
Aria: Great, thanks everyone! I'll follow the forms and thread results. :sparkles:
